risk_if_not_implemented: Without Virtual Data Room (VDR), security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Virtual Data Room (VDR) (GOV-19.1) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Assessment
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct recurring assessments of risk that includes the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction of the organization's Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Assessment (RSK-13) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Virtual Data Room (VDR) (GOV-19.1) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
